reviews.text: Dr. Steve is the best vet EVER!  My adopted dog Ash came with multiple health issues, the most problematic being GI (stomach upset, diarrhea) and hip dysplasia problems from a previous surgery. Ash had issues with diarrhea and vomiting and I could not find a vet who could help. Dr. Steve was able to get the situation under control. After he solved the initial problem, there was another complication. Dr Steve solved that problem too!   His staff is  efficient, helpful, and fun.
I admit it isn’t Cooper’s favorite place to visit but he is treated very well and always leaves happy
My cat is very shy and scared, not here.We didn't wait long.doctor was VERY thorough and knowledgeable.
I have had several pets with VMC and have been incredibly happy with their team.  They have treated a variety of issues over the years with us and the staff is always kind and incredible.

So grateful that our neighbors referred us to VMC. The entire staff is incredibly warm and accommodating. We bounced around between vets in Burbank and another one in studio city that were extremely unorganized and always going for unnecessary “upsells “. We’ve never experienced anything  but sincerity and transparency here , along with excellent care . Dr Tentser is the best :) our dog doesn’t mind the visits !

I recently moved to Studio City and was delighted to find a great vet. My first experience with the Veterinary Medical Center staff and Dr. Song was extremely positive. I will definitely take in my two other dogs to this vet.

Veterinary Medical Center has great vets, and the office staff loves animals. When I bring in Junebug, my mini-labradoodle, she's a nervous Nelly so she's always shaking. They love her and and make her feel comfortable, even during the shots and the probes and the tough stuff. They are gentle and loving and know their stuff.

I found them after a horrible experience at a nationwide vet. Luckily, VMC has caring doctors and staff who took amazing care of my late doggie Sonic when he was still with us, and are now becoming quite familiar with the new puppy who can't seem to stop injuring himself.
Oh, how I wished Dr. Steve was my doctor!vThe
Dr. Tentser and the staff at VMC are great. Easy to reach, quick to respond with reasonable pricing.
Our go to vet for years now. Friendly doctors and staff, don’t try and upsell/charge for unnecessary procedures. Recommended if looking for a vet.
My first visit with our pit-mix Viola.Great service provided by Steve Aboulafia and his cordial staff.

I have been taking my pets for care at VMC for over 20 years. Dr. Steve is the most caring and excellent vet any pet parent could ever hope for. Thank you Dr. Steve for years of quality care that you have provided to our family.

I’ve been taking my pets to VMC Studio City for years and always feel like my lil ones are in great hands.  Dr. Steve and Dr. Tentser are the truly amazing people and their warmth always comes through.  They are not alarmists when it comes to diagnosing an issue, they give feedback with reasoning to explain the options they are providing. I can’t imagine taking my pets anywhere else.
Full service and boarding .  Excellent staff.

I was fortunate to have been referred to VMC by my neighbor. Both of my dogs love to come to this vet due to the warmth and care from the front desk staff and wonderful doctors. This veterinary experience here is so refreshing and comforting. You truly feel they care about every pet that comes through their doors.  Dr Steve and Dr Tenser are amazing - from bedside manner, patience with owner questions, explaining issues and options, and making my dogs feel comfy:).

Dr. Steve Aboulafia and his staff at VMC Studio City have provided me and my pets excellent loving care since the day they opened theirs doors in 1997. I followed Dr. Steve from his previous location at Studio City Med Center. His love and dedication to his 4 legged patients is incredible. HIs staff and other veterinarians follow his lead.

Thirty years, Eight pets, and Four Vets in the Valley….We’ve met some wonderful doctors and staff. But doctors retire and staff changes have motivated us to reconsider where we do business. But we couldn’t be happier with our most recent relationship with Veterinary Medical Center in Studio City. Referred by a friend, I’ve found that several other friends are also fans/customers of Dr. Steve. Dr. Steve is patient, knowledgeable, kind, thorough and has a sense of humor that makes each visit fun. Nothing can replace the trust you develop when you put your fur babies in the hands of a good doctor. Convenient location and parking, modern, clean and attractive offices and boarding facilities, we give this vet 5 Stars.

Been using them since I got my first dog in 2005 and they have always been great and responsive to my needs. Doctor Steve is another level of Vets and sits on the floor with the animals rather than having them scared on a table. My family and I are especially grateful for your support and guidance when we had to put our dog first dog down. The calmness and care taking us through that experience made it so beautiful. Thank you!
Dr Steve, as always, was thorough and caring—and explained all that was going on with our dog. He’s taken excellent care of our dogs for a decade :)

VMC Studio City is a great general practice vet clinic.  Dr. Steve is always wonderful and so personable.  He clearly loves his patients.  His staff is equally helpful and kind.  Highly recommend this practice!

This clinic is great: great location, great space and great staff. The four-star review is for the price. A simple routine blood work inexplicably costs $284.15

Here's what Petmd.com says:

"Special blood tests vary greatly in price, but routine blood work, including a CBC and biochemistry panel, typically costs $100 to $200 for dogs and cats."

I hope the amazing staff -- like Karin at the reception, super efficient and kind -- are also paid way above average. If not, they should get a raise.

We scheduled a dental cleaning for Indy and everyone at VMC treated her as though she was their own pet.  The vet did an amazing job cleaning her teeth - their work far exceeded our expectations.  Highly recommended vet clinic, we consider ourselves lucky to have found them! :)

Truly the best veterinary center around.  Excellent service and the doctors are outstanding.  The techs and the front office are also wonderful. the animals are truly treated with compassion. They are not afraid to refer to quality specialists when needed, which is what you want in a general veterinary practice.
All my pets have come here.  They’re my family vet
Dr Steve is always so good with both Otis and myself.  I know that I’m in good hands when I’m there.  This man is willing to get down on the floor with Otis.       The whole staff is wonderful.

My cats mean the absolute world to me and this vet clinic has been nothing but amazing. From the receptionists to the techs and the Vets everyone has been welcoming and extremely understanding of mine and my cats needs. I feel that they truly care about your pets and not just about money and I always leave feeling heard and respected. 10/10 all around.

We were lucky to have Dr. Steven as our vet for both of our dogs throughout their lives. He was always kind, patient, and incredibly thorough with every visit. When we lost our pup, Dr. Steven went above and beyond by making a donation to UC Davis Veterinary School in their memory — something we’ll never forget. It was one of the most thoughtful gestures during a really difficult time. Truly the best vet and a deeply caring human being. Highly recommend Veterinary Medical Center Studio City to anyone who wants their pets treated with genuine compassion and expertise.

Friendly and efficient veterinary center!
Not all of my pet's needs require a visit with her vet. For a less costly & speedier visit, we often see a friendly tech. Their service is great, and we're quickly on our way, with my pet's issue alleviated!
Especially caring and professional.  Great facility.  Family like.

VMC cared for my beloved cat, Sidney, her entire life. She was my first pet, and the reason I chose VMC. The compassion, professionalism, and genuine love from the entire team made all the difference.

Special thanks to Dr. Steve and longtime staff members Christina, Gerardo, Raymond, and Rinaldi — you’ve been with us from beginning to end, and I’ll never forget your kindness.

Michael and I are so grateful for the care and love you gave to Sidney throughout her life. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

— Stacey C.

Dr. Debbie and VMS takes all the worry away when you bring your fur baby in. She is loving, caring, thorough and attentive as if it was her own pet.. Always does her very best to squeeze you in and is so happy to see you and your fur baby! The staff are just the same, vey helpful and accommodating.  Dr. Debbie is the very best and we love her big bunches! 🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟🤗🐾🐶❤️😘

My nervous bernedoodle was welcomed by Veterinary Medical Center, and was SO comfortable that he happily cooperated during his exam. You can really feel the difference a caring and knowledgable team makes. We're so happy to be here!
I love the team here! Dr. Steve and Dr. David are my babies doctor's and they are always making sure that they follow up with me and always take very good care of my babies.
Dr. Steve Aboulafia, loves animals, and they love him.  I call him "the pet whisperer."  What he does is magical.
The Best - have been going here for 20 years- 3 dogs and 2 cats I love this place
We love Dr. Steve and his staff. They are so nice and always smiling!!!!
Wonderful staff, very caring💞 Dr. Debbie  is the best!!! …
Excellent. The doctor and the staff truly care.

Had to rush my cat to the emergency vet. She was 22 years old and the prognosis was not good. I appreciated the way the staff handled the matter and assisted me in accepting the harsh reality of my cats condition. They were respectful and patient with me and in helping my cat peacefully transition.
This was a horrible and painful matter. But, if you are a pet owner, you already know. I wanted to give a heartfelt thank you to the staff at VCM.  I'm still coping with my loss, but I deeply appreciate all you did for me.
What an amazing and loving group of vets! My dog, Indy, is always treated so well and the staff is great and very attentive and communicative. Always appreciate their work!
I have been bringing my dogs to Dr Steve Aboulafia for over 30 years now. He has always provided the best care and the staff is always so kind and helpful. I wouldn’t take my dogs anywhere else!

First time bringing our two kitties to VMC and we were thoroughly impressed all around. The team up front was great and Dr. Tentser took his time, listened to our concerns and thoroughly advised us on the care he thought appropriate for our older boy as well as our young one. We really liked our old vet and were a little concerned about finding one that would take as good a care of us and our boys but after our first visit, we feel like we chose the right one!
Love all the staff and Dr Steve!!!
This is my dogs regular vet clinic and I’m super happy about their services and professional staff. They’re highly professional and very kind

I highly recommend this place. The doctors have always been friendly and staff cares so much about the animals. I jist moved to LA so these experiences have given me so much piece of mind knowing it’s hard to find a good veterinarian. 10/10
Super Kind, efficient, and most importantly very helpful. Brought my cat in for a check-up and couldn’t be any happier about how he was treated and cared for.
Dr. Steve is the best.  Gets on all fours with the dogs.  We miss him.

I have been going to this location since I got my first puppy in 1992.  Four consecutive dogs have been patients!  Very happy with services and the staff.  I didn’t give 4 stars because no place is perfect.  Nothing negative.  I would like …
